controles.affirmation: Judiciaire : environ 2 000 proces en cours lies a l'incendie d'Eaton au 23 juillet 2026, environ 32 000 plaignants individuels, plus plaignants en subrogation et entites publiques (Etats-Unis, comte de Los Angeles, ville de Pasadena, ville de Sierra Madre) ; proces pilote fixe a janvier 2027
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "As of July 23, 2026, SCE was aware of approximately 2,000 currently pending unsettled lawsuits related to the Eaton Fire: representing lawsuits by approximately 32,000 individual plaintiffs, lawsuits by subrogation plaintiffs and lawsuits by public entity plaintiffs, including the United States of America, the County of Los Angeles, the City of Pasadena and the City of Sierra Madre, related to the Eaton Fire. A bellwether jury trial in the Eaton Fire litigation has been set for January 2027."

controles.affirmation: Judiciaire/penal : enquete du bureau du procureur du comte de Los Angeles pour determiner si des infractions penales ont ete commises ; enquete parallele du SED ; SCE n'a pas connaissance d'un fondement a une responsabilite penale de type felony
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "SCE has transmission facilities in the preliminary area of origin and the SED is conducting an investigation with respect to the Eaton Fire. Edison International and SCE are also aware of an ongoing investigation by the Los Angeles District Attorney's Office of the Eaton Fire for the purpose of determining whether any criminal violations have occurred. [...] SCE is not aware of any basis for felony liability with regards to the Eaton Fire."

controles.affirmation: Judiciaire : SCE declare etre incapable d'estimer une fourchette de pertes supplementaires pour l'incendie d'Eaton
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 12 : "In light of pending litigation, it is probable that Edison International and SCE will incur additional material losses in connection with the Eaton Fire. [...] Edison International and SCE are currently unable to reasonably estimate a range of losses that may be incurred in connection with the Eaton Fire."

controles.affirmation: Reglementaire : inverse condemnation, responsabilite stricte independante de la faute ; a defaut, exposition en cas de negligence prouvee
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 12 : "California courts have previously found utilities to be strictly liable for property damage along with associated interest and attorneys' fees, regardless of fault, by applying the theory of inverse condemnation when a utility's facilities that are serving the public were determined to be a substantial cause of a wildfire that caused the property damage. [...] if inverse condemnation is held to be inapplicable to SCE in connection with a wildfire, SCE still could be held liable for property damages and associated interest if the property damages were found to have been proximately caused by SCE's negligence."

controles.affirmation: Reglementaire : rapport CEA d'avril 2026 remis au titre de SB 254, l'inaction exposerait a des degradations de notation et a un acces restreint au capital ; SCE ne peut predire si ni quand une legislation sera adoptee
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Credit Ratings : "In April 2026, the CEA submitted to the California Legislature and the Governor a report required under SB 254. The report observes that inaction to address escalating wildfire risk would expose utilities to risk of credit downgrades and heightened financial stress, limiting access to capital needed to maintain safe and reliable infrastructure. SCE cannot predict whether or when legislation or other measures will be adopted"

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 1 : passif sinistres incendies 1 434 M$ au 30/06/2026, dont 1 128 M$ pour Eaton, contre 897 M$ (Eaton) et 1 306 M$ (total) au 31/12/2025 ; hausse de +94,6% sur un an ; auto-assurance epuisee pour Eaton depuis le 11 fevrier 2026 ; 1,6 Md$ de pertes enregistrees au titre des reglements Eaton
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 12 tableau Accrued Losses : "Balance at December 31, 2025 | 192 | 217 | 897 | 1,306" et "| 173 | 133 | 1,128 | 1,434" (30/06/2026) ; "SCE exhausted self-insurance recoveries available for losses related to the Eaton Fire as a result of costs incurred and settlements entered into as of February 11, 2026" ; "In total, as of June 30, 2026, SCE had recorded $1.6 billion in losses related to these settlements"
controles.correction_proposee: Le +94,6% est un glissement annuel calcule contre le T2 2025 (environ 737 M$) via .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/EIX.json, et non contre les 1 306 M$ de fin 2025 cites dans le meme paragraphe (l'ecart reel sur six mois est de +9,8%). Preciser la base de comparaison pour eviter que le lecteur rapproche +94,6% de 1 306 -> 1 434.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 3 : 3,4 Mds$ de charges nettes apres impot cumulees, face a 2,8 Mds$ de passifs bruts reconnus sur l'ensemble des evenements, couverts par 3,6 Mds$ via les tarifs, 0,9 Md$ via l'auto-assurance et 0,6 Md$ via le Wildfire Fund
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 12 Recoveries : "In total, through June 30, 2026, SCE has recorded losses of $12.7 billion, expected recoveries from insurance and third parties of $2.8 billion, expected recoveries through electric rates of $3.6 billion, expected recoveries from customer-funded wildfire self-insurance of $0.9 billion, and expected recoveries from the Wildfire Fund of $0.6 billion related to the 2017/2018 Wildfire/Mudslide Events, the Other Wildfire Events, and the Eaton Fire. The after-tax net charges to earnings recorded through June 30, 2026 have been $3.4 billion."
controles.correction_proposee: Les 2,8 Mds$ sont des RECOUVREMENTS attendus aupres des assureurs et de tiers, pas des "passifs bruts reconnus". Les pertes brutes cumulees sont de 12,7 Mds$. Reecrire : "3,4 Mds$ de charges nettes apres impot, sur 12,7 Mds$ de pertes brutes enregistrees, couvertes par 2,8 Mds$ d'assurance et de tiers, 3,6 Mds$ via les tarifs electriques, 0,9 Md$ d'auto-assurance financee par les clients et 0,6 Md$ via le Wildfire Fund." En l'etat l'affirmation transforme un actif de recouvrement en passif et supprime le chiffre le plus significatif du dossier.

controles.affirmation: Resume : "la dette continue de croitre pendant que le cash-flow operationnel reste negatif"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Historical Cash Flows SCE : "Net cash provided by operating activities | $2,900 | $2,251 | $649" (six mois clos au 30 juin) ; "Net cash provided by operating activities increased by $649 million during the six months ended June 30, 2026" ; Edison International consolide : 2,697 M$ contre 2,106 M$. Le flux operationnel est positif et en hausse de 29%.
controles.correction_proposee: C'est le FREE cash flow qui est negatif, pas le flux de tresorerie operationnel. Ecrire : "la dette continue de croitre parce que le flux operationnel, pourtant positif et en hausse, ne couvre pas le programme d'investissement."

controles.affirmation: Chiffre 2 : dette long terme 40,9 Mds$ au 30/06/2026, +8,5% sur un an ; free cash flow du trimestre negatif a 576 M$
controles.verbatim_source: .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/EIX.json : lt_debt value 40.9 Mds$, yoy "+8.5%", last_data_date 2026-06-30 ; fcf value -576 M$, signal "FCF T2 2026 : -576 M$ (OCF 1 270 - capex 1 846) vs -830 M$ au T2 2025". Coherent avec le 10-Q (capex six mois 3,4 Mds$).
controles.correction_proposee: Omission orientee : le FCF s'est AMELIORE d'une annee sur l'autre (-576 M$ contre -830 M$ au T2 2025), ce que l'ATT ne mentionne pas alors qu'elle presente ce chiffre comme un signal de degradation. Ajouter la comparaison annuelle.

controles.verbatim_source: Absent du 10-Q T2 2026 cite. Le document donne un plan actualise et plus large : "SCE forecasts total capital expenditures ranging from $37.5 billion to $40.6 billion for 2026 - 2030, and weighted average annual rate base from $50.8 billion to $67.9 billion for 2026 - 2030." Les 29,3 Mds$ proviennent de .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/EIX.json, dont l'historique remonte au Q3-2024.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par le plan en vigueur dans le filing le plus recent : 37,5 a 40,6 Mds$ d'investissements sur 2026-2030.

controles.affirmation: 1,1 Md$ du plan capex dedie specifiquement a la mitigation incendies
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune occurrence dans le 10-Q T2 2026. La source interne elle-meme invalide la donnee : .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/EIX.json, KPI "Wildfire Capex", notes : "Historique retire: les 4 valeurs (Q3-2024 a Q3-2025) etaient toutes 1.1 (placeholder suspect). Verification dans les 10-Q/10-K locaux disponibles [...] aucune occurrence de '1.1 billion' ne correspond au wildfire mitigation capex plan [...] Aucun tableau chiffrant le plan wildfire mitigation capex par annee (2025-2029) n a ete localise dans les filings disponibles [...] risque de placeholder."
controles.correction_proposee: Retirer le chiffre. Il repose sur une valeur que le pipeline a lui-meme signalee comme non re-verifiable et potentiellement un placeholder.

controles.affirmation: ROE autorise par le regulateur de 10,03%
controles.verbatim_source: .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/EIX.json, KPI "ROE autorise" : value 10.03, signal "ROE 2025 autorise : 10,33% ; ROE 2026 fixe a 10,03% par decision CPUC decembre 2025", last_data_date 2026-03-31.
controles.correction_proposee: Non retrouvable en verbatim dans le 10-Q T2 2026 : la source est une extraction derivee. Preciser "ROE 2026" pour eviter l'ambiguite avec le 10,33% de 2025.
